notes: Bias and ToF scale are the five-pilot medians.
Position R uses four times endpoint residual sample variance; y variance assumed equal to x.
Endpoint residual spread is a conservative tuning proxy, not uniquely identified per-sample sensor noise.
Velocity diffusion uses the RMS middle odometry slope minus request across pilots, floored at 0.01 m/s and divided by sqrt(0.25 s).
Yaw-rate diffusion 0.06 rad/s/sqrt(s), response constants 0.25 s, startup bias ramp 2 s and initial SDs are declared priors.
Updates limited to 4 Hz per sensor to reduce repeated correlated updates; residual dependence remains.
Prototype must be reviewed on calibration data before calibration/configuration freeze.
